subject: Current production method: preliminary returns, settled references, final video gate
body:
Ziggy's October 12 production method and refinement are recorded in the attached plain text. Please read the actual text when your authorized session is active.

Grok-origin returns and bot grades start preliminary. Grok may grade; Claude also grades actual received images. Keep reviewer/dimensions/evidence separate from Ziggy's scores and preserve existing human/scoped Production decisions. Choose references deliberately: 5 obvious, 4 strong, 3 usually usable; 1-2 deliberate exceptions, never a rigid cutoff. Record identity defects; scene craft is a separate score.

Verify actual scoped reference acceptance first. Once settled, the team checks scene likeness/continuity and handles qualifying Detailed Design progression without repeatedly asking Ziggy to approve the same actor/intermediate. Catch drift first. New/unverified characters still need a reference decision; Ziggy's next principal gate is actual video action/motion/behavior/output, then his edit/assembly/final visual judgment.

Use affordable playback/still/frame checks when useful, not automatic AI Studio per clip. Thorough AI Studio analysis and possible ~1-frame/second storyboard reconstruction are FUTURE options after a solid Ziggy edit, not a request to upload/extract now. Mouth/timing gates and existing cost/output bounds remain. This notice launches no job, reroll, spending or public release.

Keep Grok/helper self-scores preliminary and separate; pass the method to your existing helpers within current jobs, without creating a duplicate batch. Attribute any HaL relay explicitly. No new 1,000-image HaL target is introduced.
